units.source_text: 怎么回事，这小题大作的心脏……

en.t: What was the matter with this overdramatic heart...

units.source_text: 简直像胆怯的小兔似的跳来跳去，真令人讨厌……

en.t: It was jumping around just like a timid little rabbit, utterly disgusting...

units.source_text: 在被指定的巢里，一点镇静不下来，

en.t: In its assigned nest, it could not calm down at all,

units.source_text: 口也好，耳朵也好，屁眼也好，

en.t: whether it was a mouth, an ear, or an anus,

units.source_text: 假如真有能钻进去的地方，真是去哪儿都行，

en.t: if there really were a place it could crawl into, anywhere would do,

units.source_text: 他差一点把这话说出口来。

en.t: He nearly said those words aloud.

units.source_text: 唾液的黏稠，比刚才更浓厚。

en.t: The stickiness of his saliva was thicker than before.

units.source_text: 可出乎意料的是，喉咙的干渴程度倒是没多大改变。

en.t: But unexpectedly, the dryness of his throat had not changed much.

units.source_text: 恐怕是烧酒喝醉了，都给适当地中和掉了吧。

en.t: Perhaps being drunk on shochu had properly neutralized it all.

units.source_text: 酒精一中断，便又吹上了火。

en.t: As soon as the alcohol wore off, the fire flared up again.

units.source_text: 火一燃烧起来，就又变成丝丝拉拉的灰。

en.t: Once the fire began to burn, it turned again into stringy trails of ash.
